headline: VMS TMT Limited withdraws prior intimation of inter-se transfer of shares by acquirer
sum: VMS TMT Limited has withdrawn its prior intimation regarding an inter-se transfer of shares by an acquirer. The withdrawal suggests a change in the proposed shareholding restructuring; no replacement transaction or revised timeline has been disclosed.
detail: VMS TMT Limited submitted a withdrawal notice to the NSE on 18 June 2026, rescinding a prior intimation of inter-se transfer of shares by an acquirer. Inter-se transfers typically occur post-acquisition when the acquirer reshuffles shareholding among group entities or nominees. The withdrawal does not disclose the original acquirer's identity, the original proposed share quantum, or the rationale for withdrawal. This is a procedural reversal; substantive deal status remains opaque without further company disclosure or regulator filing.
